---
title: "Getting Started"
---

RHS-IA combines an editor, terminal, source control, language runtimes, and data-science tools in one workspace. Open a folder for an existing project, or use **File > New Folder** to begin from a template.

## First session {#first-session}

Install or select a [Python or R interpreter](../interpreters/managing.qmd), open a source file, and run code with the editor's Run action. Output appears in the Console; objects, plots, and data open in their dedicated views.

Use **View > Command Palette** whenever you know an action but not its location. Open this guide from the Documentation icon in the Auxiliary Bar or with **Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H**.

## Next steps {#next-steps}

Learn the [workspace layout](../user-interface/layout.qmd), configure [keyboard shortcuts](../configuration/keyboard-shortcuts.qmd), or follow a [tutorial](../tutorials/overview.qmd).
